concept_attempts.feedback: Selected for closed-state morphology: asymmetric mineral support, open negative space, dark front cone and gold spiral over a pale bowl. Concept rigid-ring reading is superseded by actual sprites and the user-confirmed original upward-winding/disappearing spiral.

glb_feedback.stage: First native render; imported pass stopped at direct-parent assertion for a skinned mesh, not a complete GLB review.
discrepancies: Cone too smooth and dark, lacking original mineral relief.
Golden ribbon has repeated block-like texture bands.
corrections: Authored dark mineral colour/normal map and genuine geometric erosion.
Continuous longitudinal ribbon UVs and quieter gold variation.
Require every imported mesh to descend from placement root; glTF importer legitimately parents skinned mesh through its rig.

glb_feedback.stage: Complete saved-native/import GLB pass and state renders.
glb_feedback.discrepancy: Open bowl had a shallow filled light bottom; original and confirmed launch audit require an empty upper ring/throat.
glb_feedback.correction: Replace cap-ended bowl with a genuinely closed annular cross-section around an open central throat, darken inner walls and add a ray test through centre.

glb_feedback.discrepancy: The curved supports capped endpoint intrudes visibly into one side of the newly open throat.
glb_feedback.correction: Seat the upper arch end under the left outer bowl wall, and sample the clear aperture against every fixed mesh rather than only the bowl.

final_review: Actual independent GLB retains asymmetric open mineral support, dark front cone with blue inclusions, hollow upper bowl and golden upward-winding spiral. Feedback corrected smooth dark cone, repeated ribbon UVs filled bowl and protruding support endpoint. Actual seven native/import animated states match. Original user-confirmed winding/disappearance overrides rigid-ring reading of the concept.
limitations: Exact profiles, hidden routing, ribbon material and continuous timing are authored from raster evidence.
One skinned ribbon mesh has96bones. Hidden segments stow as tiny nonzero pieces inside the opaque base; no recovered physical engineering claimed.
Final user artistic acceptance, client state/scale/skin/shaders and Android performance remain separate.
